options.description: A browser test opens the room, swaps its files while the page is open, then checks a study's diagrams are drawn. Runs with the other tests, costs you nothing; only catches what it was written for.
options.label: A robot test (Recommended)

options.description: After any merge that changes the room, you're asked to open it and confirm the diagrams still draw. Catches more kinds of break; costs you a look each time.
options.label: You look again

options.description: You find the next break in use, as this time.
options.label: Nothing new

payload.question: The diagrams broke because your room tab stayed open while a merge replaced the room's files, and no check ever tests that situation. How should we catch that kind of break in future?
